summary: I read the inventory module's batch reservation path. In ensureInventoryLevels (packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts, lines 173-192), each entry in a createReservationItems batch is checked against the same static available_quantity and never reduced by earlier entries in that batch. createReservationItems_ (lines 277-307) then sums all entries per (inventory item, location) into reserved_quantity. So two lines that share an inventory item, in one batch, can together reserve more than stock. This matches the reported bug and the per-line-check cause. I submitted one attempt (a single cart with OVS-TWOPACK x4 and OVS-PIECE x4 against WIDGET stock 10, expecting no_oversell to fail). I have not yet seen its run results, so the claim rests on the code reading rather than an observed failure.
